# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful runs a GitHub org at partiful with the site partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful)). Its homepage describes the product as free party invites for planning events with friends ([source](https://partiful.com/)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- An older eas.json also exists in partiful-app/mobile-legacy, a second org resolving to the same company ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 is pinned in partiful/mobile's package.json ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows run in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- An open issue reports an EAS Update rollout stuck at 0% for the Android channel ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61))
- The org has 12 public repos and 180 followers ([source](https://github.com/partiful))
- The iOS app has 41,200 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570))

## Why now
The repo was last pushed on 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)). The app shipped 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).

## Suggested opener
I saw the mobile repo builds with EAS and runs React Native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)). I also noticed an open issue about an EAS Update rollout stuck at 0% on the Android channel ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)). With 6 store releases in the last 90 days, how are you splitting work between OTA updates and full store builds in your release pipeline? ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570))
